quests.name: Argent Dawn Commission
quests.summary: All who fight evil on behalf of the Argent Dawn must don our commission.  Wearing such will earn your right to claim rewards our quartermasters have to offer.While under commission, you'll be able to acquire Scourgestones from slain Scourge; these are marks of insignia that they sometimes possess.  Procure these insignia and bring them to me.  For each set you turn in, you will receive our marker of heroism - the Argent Dawn Valor Token.Achieve your destiny, <class> - join the fight today!

quests.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
quests.summary: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

quests.name: Corruptor's Scourgestones
quests.summary: A Corruptor's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's overlords.  A powerful being that holds a position of authority over the Scourge will always possess one.  To slay such a malevolent creature would surely advance the cause of the Argent Dawn, and all good causes!On behalf of the Argent Dawn, I will give you a valor token in exchange for just a single one of these insignia.  Use caution in acquiring one, <name> - such powerful beings are not to be trifled with.

quests.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
quests.summary: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Invader's Scourgestones
quests.summary: An Invader's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops.  These are sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in the Plaguelands.  Slaying such a creature is indeed a challenge, but one that should be relished with a commission to vanquish evil.The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for ten of these insignia.  Bring them to me here, and I will make sure you receive your just reward.

quests.name: Little Pamela
quests.summary: Find Pamela Redpath.

quests.name: Minion's Scourgestones
quests.summary: A Minion's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge rank and file.  These are sometimes found on the weaker of their troops positioned in the Plaguelands, though the term "weaker" is certainly to be considered in context.  The Scourge, no matter where they are, should never be underestimated.The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for twenty of these insignia - an exchange I'm happy to do, provided you have earned enough scourgestones!

quests.name: Pamela's Doll
quests.summary: Find Pamela's doll.

quests.name: Sister Pamela
quests.summary: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

quests.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
quests.summary: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: A Strange Historian
quests.summary: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

quests.name: Auntie Marlene
quests.summary: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

quests.name: Blood Tinged Skies
quests.summary: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

quests.name: Brother Carlin
quests.summary: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Carrion Grubbage
quests.summary: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

quests.name: Demon Dogs
quests.summary: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.summary: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
quests.summary: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.summary: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

quests.name: Uncle Carlin
quests.summary: Find Carlin Redpath.

quests.name: Fragments of the Past
quests.summary: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.summary: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

quests.name: Villains of Darrowshire
quests.summary: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Of Lost Honor
quests.summary: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.summary: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

quests.name: That's Asking A Lot
quests.summary: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
quests.summary: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

quests.name: To Kill With Purpose
quests.summary: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

quests.name: Tormented By the Past
quests.summary: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

quests.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
quests.summary: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

quests.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
quests.summary: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

quests.name: Anthion's Strange Request
quests.summary: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Binding the Dreadnaught
quests.summary: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Dark Iron Scraps.

quests.name: Bolstering Our Defenses
quests.summary: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Bone Fragments
quests.summary: A man in my line of work can never have too many bone fragments, <name>. Whenever you have a surplus of fragments, bring them to me and I'll reward you with another insignia.

quests.name: Bonescythe Digs
quests.summary: Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Bone Fragments.

quests.name: Chromatic Mantle of the Dawn
quests.summary: Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Core of Elements
quests.summary: Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.With that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ
quests.summary: You know the drill, kid. One valor token gets you a craftsman's writ.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Brightcloth Pants
quests.summary: Deliver 6 Brightcloth Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Brightcloth Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone
quests.summary: Deliver 120 Dense Weightstones and the Craftsman's Writ - Dense Weightstone - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Gnomish Battle Chicken
quests.summary: Deliver 4 Gnomish Battle Chickens and the Craftsman's Writ - Gnomish Battle Chicken - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Goblin Sapper Charge
quests.summary: Deliver 20 Goblin Sapper Charges and the Craftsman's Writ - Goblin Sapper Charge - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion
quests.summary: Deliver 15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe
quests.summary: Deliver 3 Huge Thorium Battleaxes and the Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest
quests.summary: Deliver 3 Imperial Plate Chests and the Craftsman's Writ - Imperial Plate Chest - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.summary: Deliver 30 Lightning Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion
quests.summary: Deliver 20 Major Healing Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Healing Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Major Mana Potion
quests.summary: Deliver 10 Major Mana Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Major Mana Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Plated Armorfish
quests.summary: Deliver 30 Plated Armorfish and the Craftsman's Writ - Plated Armorfish - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Radiant Circlet
quests.summary: Deliver 3 Radiant Circlets and the Craftsman's Writ - Radiant Circlet - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Rugged Armor Kit
quests.summary: Deliver 25 Rugged Armor Kits and the Craftsman's Writ - Rugged Armor Kit - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Bag
quests.summary: Deliver 8 Runecloth Bags and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Bag - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Boots
quests.summary: Deliver 8 Runecloth Boots and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Boots - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Robe
quests.summary: Deliver 8 Runecloth Robes and the Craftsman's Writ - Runecloth Robe - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Runic Leather Pants
quests.summary: Deliver 4 Runic Leather Pants and the Craftsman's Writ - Runic Leather Pants - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel
quests.summary: Deliver 40 Stonescale Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Stonescale Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Grenade
quests.summary: Deliver 20 Thorium Grenades and the Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Grenade - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Tube
quests.summary: Deliver 14 Thorium Tubes and the Craftsman's Writ - Thorium Tube - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Volcanic Hammer
quests.summary: Deliver 3 Volcanic Hammers and the Craftsman's Writ - Volcanic Hammer - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt
quests.summary: Deliver 9 Wicked Leather Belts and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband
quests.summary: Deliver 10 Wicked Leather Headbands and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Headband - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Crypt Fiend Parts
quests.summary: You did an exemplary job on the first bundle, <name>. If you have more, I will take them now. For every bundle that you turn in, I will reward you with another insignia.

quests.name: Cryptstalker Armor Doesn't Make Itself...
quests.summary: Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Crypt Fiend Parts.

quests.name: Dark Iron Scraps
quests.summary: For every armful of the scraps, I'll give you an insignia - the more the better. Now get out of my sight before I split you in two! Rewards Insignia of the Dawn.

quests.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
quests.summary: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

quests.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
quests.summary: For 27 Insignias of the Dawn and 27 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
quests.summary: For 110 Insignias of the Dawn and 110 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
quests.summary: For 75 Insignias of the Dawn and 75 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Epic Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
quests.summary: For 45 Insignias of the Dawn and 45 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Establishing New Outposts
quests.summary: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Whitebeard at Light's Hope Chapel.

quests.name: Hameya's Plea
quests.summary: Kill Infiltrator Hameya.  Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

quests.name: Hidden Treasures
quests.summary: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

quests.name: In Search of Anthion
quests.summary: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.

quests.name: In Search of Anthion
quests.summary: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.

quests.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
quests.summary: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

quests.name: Mantles of the Dawn
quests.summary: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
quests.summary: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.summary: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Nathanos' Ruse
quests.summary: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

quests.name: Order Must Be Restored
quests.summary: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.Keep your wits about you, <name>. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

quests.name: Proof of Life
quests.summary: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Return to Chromie
quests.summary: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.

quests.name: Return to Nathanos
quests.summary: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

quests.name: Savage Flora
quests.summary: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Savage Fronds.

quests.name: Savage Fronds
quests.summary: For every bundle of fronds that you deliver to me, I will pay you with your choice of an insignia of the Dawn or the Crusade.Insignias may be turned in to the Quartermaster for various rewards.

quests.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
quests.summary: For 6 Insignias of the Dawn and 6 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Friend of the Dawn
quests.summary: For 30 Insignias of the Dawn and 30 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
quests.summary: For 20 Insignias of the Dawn and 20 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
quests.summary: For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.

quests.name: The Argent Hold
quests.summary: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

quests.name: The Battle of Darrowshire
quests.summary: Place the Relic Bundle at the Darrowshire town square.Prevent Davil Lightfire's death until the death of Horgus.Prevent Captain Redpath's death until Redpath the Corrupted appears.Defeat Redpath the Corrupted.Speak with the spirit of Joseph Redpath when he appears at the town square, then speak with Pamela at her home.

quests.name: The Call to Command
quests.summary: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

quests.name: The Corpulent One
quests.summary: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete. A quest.

quests.name: The Crimson Courier
quests.summary: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.Take the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

quests.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
quests.summary: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
quests.summary: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 2 Arcane Crystals, 1 Nexus Crystal and 30 gold pieces. You must also be Revered with the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
quests.summary: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Eastern Plagues
quests.summary: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

quests.name: The Elemental Equation
quests.summary: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 30 Core of Elements.

quests.name: The Ice Guard
quests.summary: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.

quests.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
quests.summary: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.summary: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

quests.name: The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria
quests.summary: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

quests.name: The Shadow Guard
quests.summary: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.

quests.name: They Call Me "The Rooster"
quests.summary: Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants an Argent Dawn Valor Token.

quests.name: Writ of Safe Passage
quests.summary: Deliver the signed Writ of Safe Passage to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Use: Permanently adds 10 shadow resistance to a leg or head slot item. Does not stack with other enchantments for the selected equipment slot.
